column1: # Iliad - Part 1.5 — naskah E99008: Mityl, Kuro, dan Yoohee membuka blokade Amber Market
# dengan live streaming + tipuan suara, sampai bala bantuan Mangi Security saling tembak.
# Tetap Inggris: Mityl, Kuro, Yoohee, Sparkle Squad, Sloan, Iron Sand, Underground Brokers,
# Poludnitsa, Amber Market, Amber Bazaar, Mokosh, Mangi Security, Commander, Doll,
# Yellow Zone, IFF.

(The setting sun passed through the ajar warehouse door. Here, many truck compartments were wide open, and two soldiers were counting cargo boxes inside. The boxes were affixed with seals printed with the destination—Mokosh.)
column2: (Matahari senja menembus pintu gudang yang terbuka sedikit. Di sini, banyak bak truk terbuka lebar, dan dua tentara sedang menghitung peti kargo di dalamnya. Peti-peti itu ditempeli segel bercetak tujuan—Mokosh.)

column1: (Beep—)
column2: (Bip—)

column1: (The communication terminal suddenly rang. The two looked at each other and immediately connected.)
column2: (Terminal komunikasi tiba-tiba berbunyi. Keduanya saling pandang lalu langsung menyambungkannya.)

column1: Hey hey, it's me.
column2: Hei hei, ini aku.

column1: Captain? Please instruct.
column2: Kapten? Silakan perintahkan.

column1: We caught quite a few people again, and now we need to escort them to the warehouse. You guys come lend a hand too.
column2: Kami menangkap cukup banyak orang lagi, sekarang mereka harus digiring ke gudang. Kalian ikut bantu juga.

column1: (The two looked at each other and nodded.)
column2: (Keduanya saling pandang lalu mengangguk.)

column1: (After stacking the cargo boxes next to the vehicle, the two slung their weapons on their backs and walked out of the warehouse... With a muffled groan, there was no more movement.)
column2: (Setelah menumpuk peti kargo di samping kendaraan, keduanya menyandang senjata di punggung dan melangkah keluar gudang... Dengan satu erangan teredam, tidak ada gerakan lagi.)

column1: (The main gate was fully opened, and sunlight flooded abundantly into the warehouse, outlining three figures on the ground.)
column2: (Pintu utama terbuka penuh, dan sinar matahari membanjir masuk ke gudang, menggambar tiga siluet di lantai.)

column1: (Several Underground Brokers were squeezed in the warehouse compartment. Their hands and feet were tied, and cloth bags were over their heads. They could only judge the situation outside by sound.)
column2: (Beberapa Underground Brokers dijejalkan di bilik gudang. Tangan dan kaki mereka terikat, kepala mereka ditutup kantong kain. Mereka hanya bisa menilai situasi di luar dari suara.)

column1: (They heard the room's door lock being shattered by a gunshot, followed by someone walking into the room.)
column2: (Mereka mendengar kunci pintu ruangan hancur ditembak, lalu ada yang melangkah masuk.)

column1: ...Are you the Underground Brokers working under Poludnitsa?
column2: ...Kalian Underground Brokers yang bekerja di bawah Poludnitsa?

column1: (It sounded like a question, but the room remained dead silent.)
column2: (Kedengarannya seperti pertanyaan, tapi ruangan itu tetap sunyi total.)

column1: You're heading to Mokosh, right?
column2: Kalian menuju Mokosh, kan?

column1: (As they spoke, the Underground Brokers heard the sound of that person drawing a knife, and their heartbeats instantly accelerated—)
column2: (Saat orang itu bicara, para Underground Brokers mendengar suara pisau ditarik, dan jantung mereka seketika berdebar cepat—)

column1: (Snap!)
column2: (Krek!)

column1: (Surprisingly, the other party cut the plastic ties binding them. Then, the cloth bags over their heads were removed, revealing three girl-like Dolls to their eyes.)
column2: (Ternyata orang itu memotong pengikat plastik yang membelenggu mereka. Lalu kantong kain di kepala mereka dilepas, memperlihatkan tiga Doll berwujud anak perempuan di depan mata.)

column1: You're safe now!
column2: Kalian sudah aman!

column1: G-Girls? Your voices...?
column2: A-anak perempuan? Suara kalian...?

column1: On our way here, we found a squad of Mangi Security mercenaries, probably the ones who caught you.
column2: Di jalan menuju sini, kami menemukan satu regu tentara bayaran Mangi Security, kemungkinan mereka yang menangkap kalian.

column1: After taking care of them, Mityl used that captain's voice to disguise herself, and fooled quite a few idiots along the way, hehe!
column2: Setelah mereka diberesi, Mityl memakai suara kapten itu buat menyamar, dan berhasil mengelabui cukup banyak orang bodoh di jalan, hehe!

column1: I'm Mityl, a Doll from Mokosh.
column2: Aku Mityl, Doll dari Mokosh.

column1: (The girl returned to her pleasant voice.)
column2: (Gadis itu kembali ke suaranya yang enak didengar.)

column1: Dolls from Mokosh? So, you are that Commander's...?
column2: Doll dari Mokosh? Jadi, kalian milik Commander itu...?

column1: Mm~ The Commander sent us here to protect the supply line connecting to Mokosh~!
column2: Mm~ Commander mengirim kami ke sini untuk melindungi jalur pasokan yang menyambung ke Mokosh~!

column1: By the way, we just found a few trucks in the warehouse, they should be yours, right?
column2: Ngomong-ngomong, kami baru menemukan beberapa truk di gudang, itu punya kalian, kan?

column1: Yes, medical supplies. Sister Poludnitsa said they are urgently needed by Mokosh, but...
column2: Iya, pasokan medis. Sister Poludnitsa bilang Mokosh sangat membutuhkannya, tapi...

column1: Looks like the intel was correct. The people from Mangi Security have already reached their hands over here. Any vehicles heading that way will become their targets.
column2: Sepertinya intelnya benar. Orang-orang Mangi Security sudah mengulurkan tangan sampai ke sini. Kendaraan apa pun yang menuju ke sana akan jadi sasaran mereka.

column1: Then our next step should be—
column2: Kalau begitu langkah kita berikutnya—

column1: (The group thought for a while, then looked at the few trucks outside the room.)
column2: (Mereka berpikir sejenak, lalu menatap beberapa truk di luar ruangan.)

column1: (At nightfall, Mityl and the other two entered the Amber Market riding in the Underground Brokers' truck.)
column2: (Saat malam turun, Mityl dan dua temannya masuk ke Amber Market menumpang truk Underground Brokers.)

column1: (Before they arrived, many vehicles were already crowded in the town. Iron Sand, Underground Brokers, and liaisons from Mokosh were scattered around, either talking or arguing, and an anxious atmosphere permeated everywhere.)
column2: (Sebelum mereka datang, sudah banyak kendaraan berjejal di kota itu. Iron Sand, Underground Brokers, dan penghubung dari Mokosh berpencar di sana-sini, ada yang berbincang, ada yang berdebat, dan suasana cemas merembes ke mana-mana.)

column1: (After getting out of the car, Mityl quickly spotted Sloan dispatching manpower in the crowd; seeing Mityl approach, the other party was also taken aback.)
column2: (Setelah turun dari mobil, Mityl cepat menemukan Sloan yang sedang mengatur tenaga di tengah kerumunan; melihat Mityl mendekat, dia pun terkejut.)

column1: Mityl, Kuro? Why are you here?
column2: Mityl, Kuro? Kenapa kalian di sini?

column1: Is everything okay over at Mokosh?
column2: Semua baik-baik saja di Mokosh?

column1: The Commander sent us here after learning that the logistics line was blocked.
column2: Commander mengirim kami ke sini setelah tahu jalur logistiknya diblokir.

column1: We also saved some Underground Brokers on the way, they're over there.
column2: Kami juga menyelamatkan beberapa Underground Brokers di jalan, mereka ada di sana.

column1: The Commander...?
column2: Commander...?

column1: Speaking of which, all the trucks parked in the town here are for transporting supplies, right? This is almost bursting the town.
column2: Ngomong-ngomong, semua truk yang parkir di kota ini untuk mengangkut pasokan, kan? Kotanya hampir meledak penuh.

column1: Yes, currently the convoys transporting supplies to Mokosh are temporarily parked here.
column2: Iya, sekarang konvoi pengangkut pasokan ke Mokosh diparkir sementara di sini.

column1: The guys from Mangi Security blocked the main traffic routes for transporting supplies, and even attacked our stronghold at one point.
column2: Orang-orang Mangi Security memblokir jalur lalu lintas utama untuk mengangkut pasokan, bahkan pernah menyerang markas kami.

column1: I rushed back to help immediately after receiving the news. It's just that... holding the Amber Market is doable, but trying to break through the enemy's blockade with the Iron Sand's current forces would be very difficult.
column2: Aku langsung balik untuk membantu begitu menerima kabarnya. Hanya saja... mempertahankan Amber Market masih bisa, tapi menembus blokade musuh dengan kekuatan Iron Sand yang sekarang akan sangat sulit.

column1: However, this can't go on either. If we don't rush these support supplies to Mokosh, the Commander will...
column2: Tapi ini juga tidak bisa dibiarkan. Kalau pasokan bantuan ini tidak segera dikebut ke Mokosh, Commander akan...

column1: We're also figuring out a way, and that's not even the worst of it.
column2: Kami juga sedang mencari jalan, dan itu bahkan belum yang terburuk.

column1: A bit earlier, someone from Mokosh intercepted Mangi Security's communications.
column2: Tadi ada orang Mokosh yang menyadap komunikasi Mangi Security.

column1: They said the enemy has another batch of reinforcements arriving tonight. If we let them merge their forces, I'm afraid there won't be any possibility of breaking through the blockade.
column2: Katanya musuh punya satu gelombang bala bantuan lagi yang datang malam ini. Kalau kita biarkan kekuatan mereka bergabung, kurasa tidak akan ada lagi peluang menembus blokade.

column1: (While talking, some people nearby start arguing again over the placement of goods.)
column2: (Sambil bicara, beberapa orang di dekat mereka kembali berdebat soal penempatan barang.)

column1: Sorry I can't entertain you longer, please excuse me for a moment.
column2: Maaf aku tidak bisa menemani lebih lama, permisi sebentar.

column1: It's okay, you go ahead.
column2: Tidak apa-apa, silakan.

column1: (Sloan left under the gaze of the three.)
column2: (Sloan pergi di bawah tatapan mereka bertiga.)

column1: Miss Sloan's side is very dangerous.
column2: Posisi Miss Sloan sangat berbahaya.

column1: The enemy sending more troops at this time is obviously trying to completely block Amber Market, this logistics relay point.
column2: Musuh mengirim pasukan tambahan di waktu seperti ini jelas untuk memblokir total Amber Market, titik relai logistik ini.

column1: If they really succeed, the situation in Mokosh, having lost logistics support, will be even more severe.
column2: Kalau mereka benar-benar berhasil, situasi Mokosh yang kehilangan dukungan logistik akan makin parah.

column1: But even with the firepower of the three of us, breaking through the blockade is a bit too much of a stretch.
column2: Tapi dengan daya tembak kita bertiga saja, menembus blokade itu terlalu memaksakan.

column1: Unless we contact the Commander and send more people to help—yeah right! That would just add pressure on the Commander!
column2: Kecuali kita menghubungi Commander dan meminta lebih banyak orang—ya benar juga sih! Itu cuma menambah tekanan buat Commander!

column1: Damn it, if only there was a way to take out the enemy without firing a single shot.
column2: Sialan, kalau saja ada cara menghabisi musuh tanpa melepas satu tembakan pun.

column1: Just like the Commander, outsmart them using all possible means!
column2: Seperti Commander, akali mereka dengan segala cara yang ada!

column1: Outsmart them? This would definitely be easy for the Commander, but what can the three of us do?
column2: Mengakali? Buat Commander pasti gampang, tapi kita bertiga bisa apa?

column1: The only thing I can think of right now is to boost everyone's morale with a dance performance...
column2: Yang bisa kupikirkan sekarang cuma menaikkan moral semua orang dengan pertunjukan tari...

column1: Then I can broadcast your dance live for everyone to see—but what use is that, hey!
column2: Kalau begitu aku bisa siarkan tarianmu langsung supaya semua orang lihat—tapi apa gunanya itu, hei!

column1: Dancing, live streaming...
column2: Menari, live streaming...

column1: It seems, it's not impossible!
column2: Kelihatannya, bukan hal yang mustahil!

column1: (A few minutes later, Mityl found Sloan and, under her surprised gaze, recounted the plan the three of them had formulated.)
column2: (Beberapa menit kemudian, Mityl menemui Sloan dan, di bawah tatapan terkejutnya, menceritakan rencana yang mereka susun bertiga.)

column1: (Mangi Security's camp was driven into the ground like a wedge in the dark of night, completely sealing off the road to Mokosh, and not a single cargo transport vehicle could be seen on the road anymore.)
column2: (Kamp Mangi Security ditancapkan ke tanah seperti pasak di kelamnya malam, menutup total jalan ke Mokosh, dan tidak ada satu pun kendaraan pengangkut kargo yang terlihat lagi di jalan.)

column1: (In the camp, all soldiers maintained a hundred and twenty percent vigilance, with communication terminals transmitting chatter from time to time.)
column2: (Di dalam kamp, semua tentara menjaga kewaspadaan seratus dua puluh persen, dengan terminal komunikasi yang sesekali menyiarkan obrolan.)

column1: Are reinforcements arriving soon?
column2: Bala bantuan segera datang?

column1: Yes, estimated about forty minutes left.
column2: Ya, perkiraan sekitar empat puluh menit lagi.

column1: (In the command room at the center of the camp, the garrison captain stared at the blockade line he had deployed on the map and nodded.)
column2: (Di ruang komando di tengah kamp, kapten garnisun menatap garis blokade yang dia gelar di peta lalu mengangguk.)

column1: As long as we hold our ground here, Mokosh can forget about getting any supplies.
column2: Selama kita bertahan di sini, Mokosh boleh lupakan pasokan apa pun.

column1: Without logistical support, they won't last long.
column2: Tanpa dukungan logistik, mereka tidak akan bertahan lama.

column1: (The garrison captain savored the joy of impending victory, but the communication chatter on the terminal gradually blurred, and after a burst of static, a cheerful melody began to play—)
column2: (Kapten garnisun menikmati kegembiraan kemenangan yang sudah di depan mata, tapi obrolan komunikasi di terminal perlahan mengabur, dan setelah satu semburan derau, melodi ceria mulai berbunyi—)

column1: 『Ah—ah—can you hear my voice?』
column2: 『Ah—ah—suaraku kedengaran?』

column1: Yahoo~ Welcome to today's special live broadcast—Fired Up! Amber Market Great Counterattack! I'm your favorite streamer Kuro~! This live broadcast will go deep into the front lines to provide everyone with absolutely good stuff! Fam, don't be stingy with your planes and rockets, hurry up and send them!
column2: Yahoo~ Selamat datang di live spesial hari ini—Panas! Serangan Balik Besar Amber Market! Aku streamer favorit kalian, Kuro~! Live ini akan masuk sampai ke garis depan buat menyuguhkan barang bagus untuk semua! Fam, jangan pelit kirim pesawat dan roketnya, buruan kirim!

column1: (The defenders on alert were confused by the sudden commotion, and the defender captain also moved his eyes away from the map.)
column2: (Para penjaga yang bersiaga kebingungan dengan keriuhan yang tiba-tiba itu, dan kapten pertahanan juga mengalihkan matanya dari peta.)

column1: What's going on!
column2: Ada apa ini!

column1: Report, an unknown signal has intruded and hijacked our communication network privileges!
column2: Lapor, ada sinyal tak dikenal menyusup dan membajak hak akses jaringan komunikasi kita!

column1: The source seems to be... the Amber Bazaar!
column2: Sumbernya sepertinya... Amber Bazaar!

column1: The Amber Bazaar? Those guys from the Iron Sand Group still want to keep struggling?
column2: Amber Bazaar? Orang-orang Iron Sand Group masih mau bertahan juga?

column1: No matter, reinforcements are arriving soon. They won't be able to make any waves.
column2: Tak masalah, bala bantuan segera datang. Mereka tidak akan bisa bikin ombak.

column1: Retake the permissions immediately, we must keep communications open.
column2: Rebut kembali hak aksesnya sekarang, komunikasi harus tetap terbuka.

column1: (After giving the order here, the terminal over there began to show the scene of the Amber Market.)
column2: (Setelah perintah itu keluar, terminal di sana mulai menampilkan pemandangan Amber Market.)

column1: (In the center of the market, many Underground Brokers formed a circle, and right in the middle appeared a cute and charming girl, waving to everyone with a bright smile.)
column2: (Di tengah pasar, banyak Underground Brokers membentuk lingkaran, dan tepat di tengahnya muncul seorang gadis manis dan menawan, melambai ke semua orang dengan senyum cerah.)

column1: 'Good evening everyone, this is Yoohee from the Sparkle Squad~!'
column2: 'Selamat malam semuanya, ini Yoohee dari Sparkle Squad~!'

column1: 'This time I was commissioned by Mokosh to come to the Amber Bazaar to comfort everyone. It's been a tough journey for you all~! Yoohee will use her most passionate dance to wash away the exhaustion of your day~!'
column2: 'Kali ini aku diminta Mokosh datang ke Amber Bazaar buat menghibur semuanya. Perjalanan kalian pasti berat~! Yoohee akan memakai tarian paling bersemangat untuk menghapus lelah kalian hari ini~!'

column1: (The enthusiastic and passionate dance infects the audience at the Amber Bazaar, and also enters the sight of all the Mangi Security defenders through their terminals.)
column2: (Tarian yang penuh semangat itu menular ke penonton di Amber Bazaar, dan juga masuk ke pandangan seluruh penjaga Mangi Security lewat terminal mereka.)

column1: 'Hey hey~ Don't just stare blankly, fam, and the brothers from Mangi Security too, drop a rocket if you have one, or just tap a heart if you don't!'
column2: 'Hei hei~ Jangan cuma bengong, fam, dan bang-bang dari Mangi Security juga, kirim roket kalau punya, kalau tidak ya tap hati saja!'

column1: ...What kind of stunt is this?
column2: ...Aksi macam apa ini?

column1: 'I'm not up to anything~ I just want to bring happiness to my family through live streaming, I don't have any bad intentions~!'
column2: 'Aku tidak berbuat apa-apa~ Aku cuma mau membawa kebahagiaan buat keluargaku lewat live streaming, tidak ada niat buruk~!'

column1: They, they even hijacked the communication frequency permissions!
column2: Me-mereka bahkan membajak hak akses frekuensi komunikasi!

column1: It's just some bluffing tricks. Inform everyone immediately to heighten their guard. If we encounter an enemy attack, you are authorized to fire at will.
column2: Itu cuma tipuan gertak. Segera beri tahu semua orang untuk menaikkan kewaspadaan. Kalau ada serangan musuh, kalian berwenang menembak bebas.

column1: (After making emergency arrangements, the garrison captain looked at the terminal again.)
column2: (Setelah menyusun langkah darurat, kapten garnisun kembali menatap terminalnya.)

column1: You brats, no matter who you are, you'd better get out of our communication frequency right now, otherwise...
column2: Anak-anak nakal, siapa pun kalian, lebih baik keluar dari frekuensi komunikasi kami sekarang, kalau tidak...

column1: 'Hah? You uneducated brat, running your mouth like that? Don't you know you have to use polite language in a stream?'
column2: 'Hah? Anak tak berpendidikan, bicara seenaknya begitu? Tidak tahu ya kalau di live harus pakai bahasa yang sopan?'

column1: (The communications officer secretly glanced at the captain, whose face was flushed red with anger.)
column2: (Petugas komunikasi melirik diam-diam ke arah kapten yang wajahnya merah padam karena marah.)

column1: No matter how you play tricks, the outcome of Mokosh's destruction will not change. No matter how you struggle, it's useless!
column2: Setipu apa pun kalian bermain, akhir kehancuran Mokosh tidak akan berubah. Sekeras apa pun kalian bertahan, tidak ada gunanya!

column1: Communications officer, haven't you regained access yet?
column2: Petugas komunikasi, aksesnya belum direbut kembali?

column1: I-I'm trying to conduct electronic offense and defense, it still needs some time...
column2: S-saya sedang mencoba serangan dan pertahanan elektronik, masih butuh waktu...

column1: Hurry up! I don't want to see these brats messing up our communication channels anymore!
column2: Cepat! Aku tidak mau lagi melihat anak-anak nakal ini mengacak-acak saluran komunikasi kita!

column1: Tsk tsk, the boss moves their mouth, the subordinates run their legs off. Is this your Mangi Security's workplace culture?
column2: Cih cih, bosnya cuma gerakkan mulut, bawahannya yang capek lari-lari. Ini budaya kerja Mangi Security kalian?

column1: You—!
column2: Kau—!

column1: What what? Was there a puppy barking just now? Did anyone hear it?
column2: Apa apa? Tadi ada anak anjing menggonggong ya? Ada yang dengar?

column1: (The defender captain couldn't help but burst into profanity.)
column2: (Kapten pertahanan tidak bisa menahan diri untuk memaki-maki.)

column1: (In Amber Market, waves of furious roaring voiceprints were transmitted into Mityl's auditory system through the monitoring channel, and compiled within...)
column2: (Di Amber Market, gelombang cetak suara raungan penuh amarah itu dikirim ke sistem pendengaran Mityl melalui saluran penyadapan, lalu dikompilasi di dalamnya...)

column1: (The argument lasted for more than ten minutes. On the terminal screen, Yoohee had already started her third dance, while the defender captain had been tortured by Kuro's online roasting skills to the point of almost losing his breath several times.)
column2: (Perdebatan itu berlangsung lebih dari sepuluh menit. Di layar terminal, Yoohee sudah mulai tarian ketiganya, sementara kapten pertahanan disiksa kemampuan roasting online Kuro sampai beberapa kali hampir kehabisan napas.)

column1: Sigh, with this level of skill you actually have the nerve to go toe-to-toe with this lady. I'll take pity on you and tell you the truth—Mokosh has already sent reinforcements rushing to Amber Market!
column2: Aduh, dengan level segitu kau berani-beraninya menantang nona ini. Aku kasihan, jadi kuberi tahu yang sebenarnya—Mokosh sudah mengirim bala bantuan yang sedang melaju ke Amber Market!

column1: Take this lady's advice, hurry up and slip away, otherwise it'll be too late~!
column2: Turuti saran nona ini, buruan kabur, kalau tidak semuanya sudah telat~!

column1: Mokosh's reinforcements? Captain, this...
column2: Bala bantuan Mokosh? Kapten, ini...

column1: (Catching his breath, the garrison captain calmed down a bit.)
column2: (Setelah mengatur napas, kapten garnisun agak tenang.)

column1: The reason these brats hacked into our communication network is to pull some tactical deception.
column2: Alasan anak-anak nakal ini membajak jaringan komunikasi kita adalah untuk menjalankan tipuan taktis.

column1: News came back from the front lines early on that Mokosh is already stretched thin, it's absolutely impossible...
column2: Kabar dari garis depan sudah lama masuk bahwa Mokosh sudah kewalahan, jadi mustahil...

column1: (Suddenly an explosion sounded in the camp, forcefully choking back the garrison captain's words.)
column2: (Tiba-tiba ledakan berbunyi di dalam kamp, memaksa kata-kata kapten garnisun tertelan kembali.)

column1: <size=28>Report! Enemy attack—!!!</size>
column2: <size=28>Lapor! Serangan musuh—!!!</size>

column1: (Gunshots rang out everywhere. The unprepared defenders hastily returned fire, and the camp instantly fell into chaos.)
column2: (Letusan senjata berbunyi di mana-mana. Penjaga yang tidak siap buru-buru membalas tembakan, dan kamp seketika kacau.)

column1: H-How is that possible!? Did Mokosh really send reinforcements!?
column2: M-mana mungkin!? Mokosh benar-benar mengirim bala bantuan!?

column1: Can we identify the enemy's intelligence!
column2: Bisa identifikasi data musuhnya!

column1: N-Not clear, the signal is jammed, unable to detect IFF information!
column2: T-tidak jelas, sinyalnya diganggu, tidak bisa mendeteksi informasi IFF!

column1: Damn it... where are our reinforcements!? We must contact them immediately!
column2: Sialan... di mana bala bantuan kita!? Harus segera dihubungi!

column1: (The defender captain picked up the terminal and tried to contact his own reinforcements, but the terminal screen only showed Yoohee dancing gorgeously, and Amber Market whose passion had already been ignited.)
column2: (Kapten pertahanan mengambil terminalnya dan mencoba menghubungi bala bantuannya, tapi layar terminal hanya menampilkan Yoohee yang menari memukau, dan Amber Market yang semangatnya sudah tersulut.)

column1: <size=28>Damn it... damn it!!!</size>
column2: <size=28>Sialan... sialan!!!</size>

column1: (Smashing the terminal in his hand to pieces, the defender captain drew his pistol and roared.)
column2: (Menghancurkan terminal di tangannya berkeping-keping, kapten pertahanan menarik pistolnya dan meraung.)

column1: Organize a counterattack immediately, we absolutely cannot let them break through the blockade!
column2: Segera susun serangan balik, kita sama sekali tidak boleh membiarkan mereka menembus blokade!

column1: (After a fierce battle, the defenders almost put all their forces on the line.)
column2: (Setelah pertempuran sengit, para penjaga hampir menaruh seluruh kekuatannya di garis itu.)

column1: (The crossfire between the two sides came to an abrupt end only when the sky turned pale. The defender captain looked with a distorted face at the "enemy" opposite, who was also dressed in Mangi Security attire, and everyone immediately started cursing.)
column2: (Tembak-menembak kedua pihak baru berhenti mendadak saat langit mulai memutih. Kapten pertahanan menatap dengan wajah terdistorsi ke "musuh" di seberang, yang juga berseragam Mangi Security, dan semua orang seketika mulai memaki.)

column1: H-How could this be!?
column2: B-bagaimana bisa begini!?

column1: Oh my, didn't I tell you? Your reinforcements received your call for help and came to attack the 'Mokosh defenders stationed at the traffic artery of Amber Market'. Unfortunately, you happen to be in the position being attacked~!
column2: Aduh, bukannya sudah kubilang? Bala bantuan kalian menerima panggilan minta tolong kalian lalu datang menyerang 'penjaga Mokosh yang bercokol di jalur utama Amber Market'. Sayangnya, kalian yang kebetulan ada di posisi yang diserang~!

column1: My call for help!?
column2: Panggilan minta tolongku!?

column1: Yes, it was 'my' call for help.
column2: Iya, itu panggilan minta tolong 'milikku'.

column1: Thanks to this voice, your people believed it very easily. Thanks a lot~!
column2: Berkat suara ini, orang-orangmu percaya dengan sangat mudah. Terima kasih banyak ya~!

column1: (Hearing the young girl in the terminal emit his own voice, the defender captain's mind was like a bomb had been detonated, unable to think anymore. The remaining defenders were also powerless to fight again, and were easily completely surrounded and annihilated by the Iron Sand Gang, who had been waiting at ease.)
column2: (Mendengar gadis kecil di terminal itu mengeluarkan suaranya sendiri, pikiran kapten pertahanan seperti diledakkan bom, tidak bisa berpikir lagi. Penjaga yang tersisa juga tidak berdaya untuk bertempur lagi, dan dengan mudah dikepung serta dihabisi Iron Sand Gang yang sejak tadi menunggu santai.)

column1: (The battle completely ended, the sky was already bright, and the Iron Sand Gang began to clear the battlefield.)
column2: (Pertempuran berakhir sepenuhnya, langit sudah terang, dan Iron Sand Gang mulai membersihkan medan tempur.)

column1: (The key route originally guarded by Mangi Security troops was cleared of an exit in advance, and the Underground Brokers' convoy, originally congested at the Amber Market, began to pass through in an orderly manner.)
column2: (Jalur kunci yang semula dijaga pasukan Mangi Security dibukakan satu jalan keluar lebih dulu, dan konvoi Underground Brokers yang tadinya menumpuk di Amber Market mulai melintas dengan tertib.)

column1: (Yoohee and Kuro stood at the exit, waving goodbye to the passing convoy.)
column2: (Yoohee dan Kuro berdiri di jalan keluar, melambaikan tangan mengantar konvoi yang lewat.)

column1: Thanks for your hard work, wishing everyone a safe journey~!
column2: Terima kasih atas kerja kerasnya, semoga semuanya selamat di jalan~!

column1: Pay attention to safety on the road. If you run into those guys from Mangi Security, remember to contact us!
column2: Hati-hati di jalan. Kalau ketemu orang-orang Mangi Security, ingat hubungi kami!

column1: Miss Yoohee! Yesterday's performance was amazing! If the Sparkle Squad has new performances in the future, we will definitely go support you!
column2: Miss Yoohee! Pertunjukan semalam luar biasa! Kalau Sparkle Squad punya pertunjukan baru nanti, kami pasti datang mendukung!

column1: Wow~ Thank you!
column2: Wah~ Terima kasih!

column1: M-Miss Yoohee, before you leave, could we take a picture with you?
column2: M-Miss Yoohee, sebelum pergi, boleh kami berfoto denganmu?

column1: W-We want to as well!
column2: K-kami juga mau!

column1: And autographs too, please!
column2: Tanda tangan juga, ya!

column1: (Many Underground Brokers intended to get out of their cars to find Yoohee for a group photo and ask for an autograph, but ended up being constantly urged by the honking from the vehicles behind them.)
column2: (Banyak Underground Brokers berniat turun dari mobil untuk mencari Yoohee demi foto bersama dan tanda tangan, tapi akhirnya terus diburu klakson kendaraan di belakang mereka.)

column1: Tsk tsk, you actually gained so many new fans in one night, Yoohee, you...
column2: Cih cih, dalam satu malam kau dapat fans baru sebanyak itu, Yoohee, kau ini...

column1: Kuro, Yoohee... Wow! Why is there a traffic jam here??
column2: Kuro, Yoohee... Wah! Kenapa di sini macet??

column1: Go ask our super idol Miss Yoohee.
column2: Tanya saja ke super idol kita, Miss Yoohee.

column1: D-Don't make fun of me...
column2: J-jangan menggodaku...

column1: Mityl, did the Commander reply to our battle report?
column2: Mityl, Commander sudah membalas laporan tempur kita?

column1: Mhm, replied. The Commander also said that our performance this time was very good, and when the battle is won, they will give us any reward we want!
column2: Mhm, sudah. Commander juga bilang penampilan kita kali ini sangat bagus, dan kalau pertempurannya menang, kita boleh minta hadiah apa saja!

column1: Eh? Anything is fine?
column2: Eh? Apa saja boleh?

column1: Heeheehee~!
column2: Hihihi~!

column1: Stop fantasizing first, you...
column2: Berhenti berfantasi dulu, kau ini...

column1: I just saw Miss Sloan. She will lead the Iron Sand Group to continue reinforcing the security around the Amber Bazaar to prevent the transportation routes from falling into enemy hands again.
column2: Aku baru bertemu Miss Sloan. Dia akan memimpin Iron Sand Group untuk terus memperkuat keamanan di sekitar Amber Bazaar supaya jalur transportasinya tidak jatuh lagi ke tangan musuh.

column1: Now that the crisis is resolved, we should head out and take a look elsewhere.
column2: Karena krisisnya sudah beres, kita sebaiknya berangkat dan melihat tempat lain.

column1: The people from Mangi Security won't let this go. I hope these supplies can be successfully delivered to Mokosh...
column2: Orang-orang Mangi Security tidak akan tinggal diam. Kuharap pasokan ini bisa sampai ke Mokosh dengan lancar...

column1: Ha~ As long as we're here, we won't let them succeed~!
column2: Ha~ Selama kami ada di sini, kami tidak akan membiarkan mereka berhasil~!

column1: (The three exchanged a smile and immediately set off for the next destination.)
column2: (Mereka bertiga bertukar senyum lalu langsung berangkat ke tujuan berikutnya.)

column1: (The wilderness of the Yellow Zone stretched as far as the eye could see. The logistics lifeline formed by the Underground Brokers' convoy was surging towards Mokosh.)
column2: (Padang belantara Yellow Zone terbentang sejauh mata memandang. Nadi logistik yang dibentuk konvoi Underground Brokers itu mengalir deras menuju Mokosh.)
